mapper.sql: FROM T_PAY_TRAN_L p JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M w ON p.wallet_id = w.id AND w.type = 'MEMBER'
mapper.select: SELECT id, `role`, birth_date, created_at FROM T_MBR_INFO_M WHERE id = #{childId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, COALESCE(c.name, '미분류') AS category_name, p.applied_policy AS applied_policy, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
LEFT JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON c.id = p.category_id
GROUP BY p.category_id, c.name, p.applied_policy ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_count DESC, category_name ASC

SELECT DATE(p.created_at) AS spent_date, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
GROUP BY DATE(p.created_at) ORDER BY spent_date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.paid_principal_amount), 0) AS paid_principal, COALESCE(SUM(r.paid_interest_amount), 0) AS paid_interest, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repaid_count FROM T_LON_REPAYHIST_H r JOIN T_LON_ENROLL_M e ON e.id = r.loan_enrollment_id WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND r.paid_at >= #{from} AND r.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.status = 'OVERDUE'), 0) AS overdue_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e2.outstanding_principal), 0) FROM T_LON_ENROLL_M e2 WHERE e2.child_id = #{childId} AND e2.status = 'OVERDUE') AS outstanding_principal FROM T_LON_REPAYHIST_H r JOIN T_LON_ENROLL_M e ON e.id = r.loan_enrollment_id WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.status = 'OVERDUE'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.status = 'APPROVED'), 0) AS approved_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.status = 'REJECTED'), 0) AS rejected_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.status = 'EXPIRED'), 0) AS expired_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.reason IS NOT NULL AND r.reason <> ''), 0) AS reason_written_count FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r WHERE r.child_id = #{childId} AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.status = 'COMPLETED' AND q.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND q.ended_at >= #{from} AND q.ended_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(q.status = 'FAILED' AND q.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND q.ended_at >= #{from} AND q.ended_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(q.status = 'EXPIRED' AND q.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND q.ended_at >= #{from} AND q.ended_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS expired_count, COALESCE(SUM(q.status = 'DECLINED' AND q.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND q.ended_at >= #{from} AND q.ended_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS declined_count,
COALESCE(SUM(q.status <> 'AVAILABLE' AND q.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (q.ended_at IS NULL OR q.ended_at >= DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))), 0) AS in_progress_count FROM T_QST_BASE_M q WHERE q.child_id = #{childId}

SELECT 'DEPOSIT' AS product_type, e.id AS enrollment_id, p.name AS product_name, e.status AS status, e.maturity_date, DATE(e.closed_at) AS closed_on, COALESCE(w.balance, 0) AS amount FROM T_DPT_ENROLL_M e LEFT JOIN T_DPT_PROD_M p ON p.id = e.deposit_id LEFT JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M w ON w.id = e.wallet_id WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED', 'TERMINATED') AND ( (e.maturity_date >= #{from} AND e.maturity_date <= #{monthEnd}) OR (e.closed_at >= #{from} AND e.closed_at < DATE_ADD(#{monthEnd}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SAVING', e.id, p.name, e.status, e.maturity_date, DATE(e.closed_at), COALESCE(w.balance, 0) FROM T_SVG_ENROLL_M e LEFT JOIN T_SVG_PROD_M p ON p.id = e.saving_id LEFT JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M w ON w.id = e.wallet_id WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED', 'TERMINATED') AND ( (e.maturity_date >= #{from} AND e.maturity_date <= #{monthEnd}) OR (e.closed_at >= #{from} AND e.closed_at < DATE_ADD(#{monthEnd}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) )

SELECT h.amount, h.event_code, h.description, h.created_at FROM T_TNY_SCOREHIST_H h WHERE h.child_id = #{childId} AND h.created_at >= #{from} AND h.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY h.created_at

SELECT DISTINCT ym FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS ym FROM T_PAY_TRAN_L p JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M w ON w.id = p.wallet_id AND w.type = 'MEMBER' WHERE w.member_id = #{childId} AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM T_WLT_TRF_L t JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M fw ON fw.id = t.from_wallet_id JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M tw ON tw.id = t.to_wallet_id WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED' AND (fw.member_id = #{childId} OR tw.member_id = #{childId}) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.paid_at, '%Y-%m') FROM T_LON_REPAYHIST_H r JOIN T_LON_ENROLL_M le ON le.id = r.loan_enrollment_id WHERE le.child_id = #{childId} AND r.paid_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(q.ended_at, '%Y-%m') FROM T_QST_BASE_M q WHERE q.child_id = #{childId} AND q.ended_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM T_TDP_REQ_L pr WHERE pr.child_id = #{childId} UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sh.created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM T_TNY_SCOREHIST_H sh WHERE sh.child_id = #{childId} ) months WHERE ym IS NOT NULL

SELECT e.start_date AS start_date, COALESCE(DATE(e.closed_at), e.maturity_date) AS end_date FROM T_DPT_ENROLL_M e WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.start_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.start_date, COALESCE(DATE(e.closed_at), e.maturity_date) FROM T_SVG_ENROLL_M e WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.start_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.start_date, e.maturity_date FROM T_LON_ENROLL_M e WHERE e.child_id = #{childId} AND e.start_date IS NOT NULL
